title: Red Hat Security Advisory: bind9.16 security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: Multiple security vulnerabilities have been identified in BIND 9.16, a widely used implementation of DNS protocols. These include several denial of service (DoS) issues caused by crafted DNS messages, DNSSEC replies, DNS64 responses, and assertion failures during redirect and RPZ query processing. Additionally, an arbitrary code execution vulnerability via GSS-TSIG UDP message replay has been reported. Red Hat has released an important security update for BIND 9.16 on Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8.8 to address these issues along with bug fixes and enhancements.
